vocabulary.meaning_en: a competition to see who is fastest
vocabulary.example: She came first in the race.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit hard with your closed hand
vocabulary.example: Boxers punch each other in the ring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how heavy someone or something is
vocabulary.note_en: The 'gh' is silent: it sounds like 'wait'.
vocabulary.example: Boxers fight others of the same weight.
She achieved her goal of running 10 km.
I expect it will rain later.

vocabulary.meaning_en: too much worry or excitement about something small
vocabulary.example: He made a big fuss about a tiny scratch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to react more strongly than is necessary
vocabulary.example: Don't overreact – it's only a small mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long soft seat; a sofa
vocabulary.example: He fell asleep on the couch.
They delayed the meeting until Friday.
I want to improve my English.
He took another road to avoid the traffic.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person learning to do a job
vocabulary.example: The new trainee starts on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you feel shy or silly in front of others
vocabulary.example: It was embarrassing when I forgot her name.

fine_lines.title: a walk in the park vs like riding a bike
fine_lines.explanation_ar: a walk in the park = شيء سهل جداً. like riding a bike = مهارة تعلّمتها مرة فلن تنساها أبداً حتى بعد مدة طويلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'A walk in the park' means something very easy. 'Like riding a bike' means a skill you never forget once you learn it.

examples.sentence: The first exam was a walk in the park.
I hadn't swum for years, but it was like riding a bike.

fine_lines.title: up your game vs bring your A game
fine_lines.explanation_ar: up/raise your game = حسِّن أداءك ليصبح أفضل مما كان. bring your A game = قدّم أفضل أداء لديك في مناسبة مهمة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Up (or raise) your game' = improve your performance. 'Bring your A game' = give your very best performance on an important occasion.

examples.sentence: If we want to win, we need to up our game.
Bring your A game to the interview tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: do a runner vs kick into the long grass
fine_lines.explanation_ar: do a runner = يهرب من مكان لتجنّب موقف صعب (أو دون أن يدفع). kick something into the long grass = يؤجّل قراراً أو خطة صعبة على أمل أن تُنسى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Do a runner' = leave a place suddenly to avoid a difficult situation (or paying). 'Kick something into the long grass' = delay a difficult decision, hoping it will be forgotten.

examples.sentence: The trainee did a runner after one day.
The council kicked the new road plan into the long grass.

expressions.example: After all that practice, the driving test was a walk in the park.

expressions.meaning_en: a skill you never forget once you have learned it
expressions.example: I hadn't cooked rice for years, but it's like riding a bike.

expressions.meaning_ar: رقص غير متناسق ومحرج بطريقة مضحكة، كرقص الآباء في الحفلات العائلية
expressions.meaning_en: awkward, old-fashioned dancing, like a dad at a family party
expressions.example: My uncle's dad dancing at the wedding made everyone laugh.

expressions.meaning_en: to achieve more than people expect from you
expressions.example: Our small school punches above its weight in science competitions.

expressions.phrase: make a song and dance about something
expressions.meaning_ar: يُثير ضجة كبيرة غير ضرورية حول شيء
expressions.meaning_en: to make an unnecessary fuss about something
expressions.example: It's only one plate – don't make a song and dance about it.
She brought her A game to the final and won.

expressions.meaning_ar: الإقامة مؤقتاً مجاناً عند الآخرين والنوم على الأريكة
expressions.meaning_en: staying for free in other people's homes for a short time, often on the sofa
expressions.example: He has been couch surfing at friends' houses since he moved to the city.

expressions.phrase: kick something into the long grass
expressions.meaning_ar: يؤجل قراراً أو خطة صعبة على أمل أن تُنسى
expressions.meaning_en: to delay a difficult decision or plan, hoping it will be forgotten
expressions.example: The plan for a new bridge was kicked into the long grass.

expressions.phrase: up your game / raise your game
expressions.example: You'll need to up your game to pass the next level.

expressions.meaning_ar: يهرب فجأة لتجنّب موقف صعب (أو دون أن يدفع)
expressions.meaning_en: to leave suddenly to avoid a difficult situation (or without paying)
expressions.example: The man did a runner when the shop assistant asked for his receipt.

grammar.title: Possessive adjectives in idioms: your / my / his / her / their
grammar.explanation_ar: تعابير مثل punch above your weight و up your game تتغير فيها your حسب الفاعل: I up my game، she punches above her weight، they need to up their game. لا نقول she punches above your weight.
grammar.explanation_en: In idioms like 'punch above your weight' and 'up your game', 'your' changes to match the subject: I up my game, she punches above her weight, they need to up their game.
examples: I need to up my game.
Our team punches above its weight.

questions.question: 'The test was a walk in the park.' The test was...
questions.explanation_ar: a walk in the park = سهل جداً.
questions.explanation_en: 'A walk in the park' means very easy.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: She needs to up your game.
She needs to up her game.
She needs to up hers game.
questions.explanation_ar: your تتغير حسب الفاعل: she → her.
questions.explanation_en: 'Your' changes with the subject: she → her.

questions.question: A small country that wins many medals ___.
questions.explanation_ar: punch above your weight = يحقق أكثر من المتوقع.
questions.explanation_en: It means achieving more than expected.

questions.question: 'Don't make a song and dance about it.' What does it mean?
choices: Don't make a big fuss about it.
questions.explanation_ar: make a song and dance = يثير ضجة غير ضرورية.
questions.explanation_en: It means making an unnecessary fuss.

questions.question: He has no home right now, so he's sleeping at friends' houses. He's ___.
choices: kicking it into the long grass
questions.explanation_ar: couch surfing = الإقامة مؤقتاً عند الآخرين.
questions.explanation_en: 'Couch surfing' is staying at others' homes for a short time.

questions.question: 'I haven't played chess for years, but it's ___.'
questions.explanation_ar: like riding a bike = مهارة لا تُنسى.
questions.explanation_en: 'Like riding a bike' means you never forget it.

questions.question: The government ___ the difficult decision into the long grass.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير: kick something into the long grass.
questions.explanation_en: The idiom is 'kick something into the long grass'.

questions.question: What is your 'A game'?
questions.explanation_en: Your 'A game' is your best performance.

questions.question: The new worker left after one day without telling anyone. He ___.
questions.explanation_en: 'Do a runner' means leave suddenly to avoid something.

questions.question: Which two expressions are about improving or giving your best?
choices: walk in the park / song and dance
questions.explanation_ar: up your game و A game كلاهما عن الأداء الأفضل.
questions.explanation_en: 'Up your game' and 'A game' are both about best performance.
